Qualcomm is hiring a Wireless Software Engineer for its Systems Test Engineering group. The role performs system-level testing of WLAN and Bluetooth connectivity products, develops and automates test procedures, analyzes results, debugs issues, and collaborates with engineering teams on commercialization and product launches.

Responsibilities
Perform System level testing for wireless connectivity products, especially WLAN and Bluetooth
Test:
+ Protocol functionality
+ End-to-end system behavior
+ Performance
+ Physical layer and RF features
Develop and execute test cases under various operational scenarios
Analyze results, debug issues, and provide recommendations
Enhance and automate test procedures and analysis tools
Work closely with system, software, hardware, and RF engineers to support commercialization and product launches

• WLAN/BT system validation

• Wireless protocol analysis
• Performance benchmarking
• RF and PHY validation

• Competitive analysis and issue triage
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field
Preferred
• WLAN technologies (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be)
• OFDMA and MIMO concepts
• Test automation experience
• WLAN packet/sniffer analysis
• Programming in Python
• 1 to 2 years of hands-on system testing and debugging experience is considered a plus
• Experience with WLAN and Bluetooth testing is preferred
• Experience developing automated test solutions and/or Python programming skills
• MSEE (Master's in Electrical Engineering) preferred
• MSCE (Master's in Computer Engineering) with testing experience is also suitable
